parameters.text:
Personal Assistant v2

Just talk naturally.

Try:
- spent 500 on lunch
- meeting with John at 3pm tomorrow
- I slept 6 hours
- save this article: [url]
- what do I know about Supabase?
- I have an idea - AI meal planner
- how's [project] going?

Commands:
/status - tasks and projects
/checkin - evening reflection
/plan - morning brief
/done <id> - complete task
/list - all tasks
/help - this message
